title: 「It turns out that + 子句 ／ X turns out to be Y」表示後來發現的真相
titleZh: 「It turns out that + 子句 ／ X turns out to be Y」表示後來發現的真相
titleEn: It turns out that + clause / X turns out to be Y

source.file: Sentence Structure 246 -「It turns out that + 子句 _ X turns out to be Y」表示後來發現的真相.pdf
omissions: Every numbered Important Rule and Benefit is retained as a separate Chinese-primary card. Where the PDF has no complete English counterpart, the English explanation is a faithful editorial translation.
The source filename is numbered 246; it is assigned system ID ss247 because the source set contains two distinct PDFs labelled 201.

formula: It + turns / turned out + that + complete clause

formulas.formula: It + turns / turned out + that + complete clause
Subject + turns / turned out + to be + noun / adjective / other description
It may / might / could turn out that + clause
Subject + may / might / could turn out to be + Y
Subject + turns / turned out not to be + Y

example: It turned out that the figures were wrong.

examples.en: It turned out that the figures were wrong.
examples.highlight: It turned out that the figures were wrong.

examples.en: The figures turned out to be wrong.
examples.zh: 這些數字後來證實是錯的。
examples.highlight: The figures turned out to be wrong.

examples.zh: 問題後來證實並不嚴重。
examples.highlight: The problem turned out not to be serious.

meaning.zh: 說明經過了解、檢查、調查或一段時間後才發現真正情況；原先想法可能不正確，最終結果也可能與預期不同。

rules.zh: 核心有兩種：It turns out that 後接完整子句；X turns out to be Y 把要描述的人或事物放句首，Y 可為名詞、形容詞、位置或情況。
rules.en: Use the two core patterns correctly. It turns out that introduces a complete clause; X turns out to be Y places the item being described first and follows it with a noun, adjective, location or other description.

rules.zh: 第一種把焦點放在整項發現，第二種把焦點放在 X 的真正身分、性質或情況。
rules.en: Choose the pattern according to focus: the that-clause highlights the whole discovery, while X turns out to be Y highlights the true identity, quality or state of X.

rules.zh: 含一般動作的 that 子句不一定能改成 to be；只有 X + be + Y 類內容通常可自然轉換。
rules.en: Not every that-clause can become a to be pattern. General actions normally remain in a complete that-clause; descriptions of the form X + be + Y usually allow both patterns.
examples: It turned out that Leo had sent the email.

rules.zh: turns out 用於現在才知道或目前適用的事實；turned out 用於過去已完成的發現或事件。
rules.en: Use turns out for a newly discovered or currently applicable fact, and turned out for a completed discovery or past event.

rules.zh: 情態動詞後使用原形 turn out，不使用 turns out 或 turned out。
rules.en: Use the base form turn out after may, might or could.
examples: The new method might turn out to be more effective.

rules.zh: 第一句型的否定放在 that 子句內；第二句型通常使用 turned out not to be。
rules.en: Place negation inside the that-clause in Pattern 1; Pattern 2 normally uses turn out not to be.

rules.zh: Later、Eventually、After further testing 或條件子句只是可選背景，不是固定核心。
rules.en: Opening time and condition information such as Later, Eventually or After further testing is optional context rather than part of the fixed expression.

rules.zh: 本課不包括 turn out 表示「結果變成」或「出席」的其他意思。
rules.en: Do not confuse the target discovery meaning with turn out meaning develop successfully or attend an event.

rules.zh: 本課保留 that，以便清楚辨認完整句型，即使非正式口語有時會省略。
rules.en: Keep that in the target pattern for clarity, even though informal speech sometimes omits it.

rules.zh: 本課不包括 turned out to have been 等較進階形式，核心只練習 turn out that + clause 和 turn out to be + description。
rules.en: Advanced perfect-infinitive forms are outside this lesson; practise only turn out that + clause and turn out to be + description.

benefits.zh: 以自然句型表達「後來才發現」，避免每次都寫 We later discovered 或 We eventually found。
benefits.en: It naturally expresses a later discovery without repeatedly using We later discovered or We eventually found.

benefits.zh: 清楚顯示原先想法與真正情況可能不同，適合意外、誤會和調查結果。
benefits.en: It clearly shows that an earlier belief and the true situation may differ.

benefits.zh: 可按需要把焦點放在整項發現，或放在某個人或事物上。
benefits.en: It lets the writer focus either on the whole discovery or on the person or thing whose true nature is revealed.

benefits.zh: 適合故事、報告、檢查結果、錯誤解釋和意外發現。
benefits.en: It is useful in stories, reports, explanations of errors, inspection results and unexpected discoveries.

benefits.zh: 無需反覆說明是誰發現真相，可直接把重點放在被發現的人或事物。
benefits.en: It avoids repeating we found or we discovered and can place the subject matter directly in focus.

benefits.zh: 配合 may、might 或 could，可審慎表示仍有待證實的可能性。
benefits.en: With may, might or could, it expresses an outcome that remains possible rather than confirmed.

en: Rewrite each sentence using either It turns / turned out that + clause or X turns / turned out to be Y.
Use may, might or could when the original sentence expresses possibility.
